articles.title: Key stats before Arsenal face Man City in Community Shield
articles.description: On Sunday, the first piece of silverware of the season will be contested for in Cardiff as Premier League champions Arsenal face FA Cup winners Manchester City in the Community Shield.  Only Manchester United (21) have won the Community Shield more often than they have (17, including shared), with the Gunners winning each of their past five.  Arsenal have also won all three matches when competing as reigning Premier League champions (1998, 2002, 2004).
